verdict.rationale: Highnote's Secure Inputs SDK for PINs lets cardholders set and update their PIN from the developer's own UI through PCI-safe iframes, so PIN management is self-serve and needs no support ticket. The pack has no evidence on 3DS enrollment, which is half the story. missing for 10: any 3DS enrollment or online-authentication configuration via API, explicit PIN reset flow documentation (only set/update is described), API-level (non-SDK) PIN mutation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
